description: Complete Grist typed record observations with document-state and schema comparison, private capture portability, original dataset publisher and SF82 releases.

commandDescriptions.grist-source: Inspect actual Grist document/table metadata, retain complete typed responses and document heads, resume exact requests and import or freeze private observations.
commandDescriptions.grist-publisher: Review and publish Grist dataset editions through the original publisher.
commandDescriptions.grist-deployment: Review and package published Grist editions, stage original seller releases and operate the release console.
